description: Settled jury seats per grader in a segment: seats, aligned, aligned rate, settled score mean (0 to 3), closes graded, last close, and open_seats, minepoa's public count of seats assigned this epoch (read by POAScan once per epoch in the background, current segment only). With address: that grader's per close rows and its settled seats (answer, close, passed, aligned, score). Settled only: pending seals carry no score and none is shown. Use it for a grader's track record or jury load. CSV at /api/v1/governance/grade-history.csv.

address.description: a poa1... Agent address (base58, as shown on POAScan or LabLeak)

dir.description: desc (default: highest first, A to Z for names) or asc (reversed); blanks last

limit.description: maximum graders to return (1 to 5000, default 100)

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

sort.description: row order without address: seats (default), name (A to Z), aligned, rate, avg, closes, last or open

name: get_grade_history
title: Grade history
